description: This file contains automated tests for authentication endpoints in a FastAPI application, including signup, login, and 'me' user info retrieval. It sets up test fixtures with a temporary SQLite database and tests various scenarios such as successful signup/login, duplicate signups, validation errors, CORS preflight requests, and token payload assertions.

methods.name: Generator[Session,None,None] db_session()
methods.description: Fixture that creates a temporary SQLite database and provides a SQLAlchemy session for testing.

methods.name: TestClient client(db_session: Session)
methods.description: Fixture that overrides the app dependency to provide the test database session, returning a TestClient.

methods.name: test_signup_login_me_flow(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests the full flow of signup, login, and retrieving current user info, including duplicate signup and token validation.

methods.name: test_me_requires_auth(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Ensures that accessing '/auth/me' without authentication returns a 401 error.

methods.name: test_cors_preflight_signup(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Simulates an OPTIONS preflight request to verify CORS headers are properly set for '/auth/signup'.

methods.name: test_cors_post_signup_includes_headers(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Checks that a POST request to '/auth/signup' with Origin includes the correct CORS headers and correlation headers.

methods.name: test_cors_post_login_invalid_includes_headers(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Verifies CORS headers are included in responses for failed login attempts.

methods.name: test_cors_post_login_success_includes_headers(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Verifies CORS headers on successful login responses and correct headers like Vary and expose headers.

methods.name: test_duplicate_signup_returns_409_with_cors(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests that duplicate signup attempts return a 409 Conflict with appropriate CORS headers when Origin is provided.

methods.name: test_signup_validation_error_returns_422_with_cors(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Asserts that invalid signup payloads produce a 422 error with CORS headers.

methods.name: test_login_validation_error_returns_422_with_cors(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Asserts that invalid login payloads produce a 422 error with CORS headers.

methods.name: test_login_response_token_shape(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Checks that a login response contains a valid JWT token with essential claims after signing up a user.

methods.name: test_login_returns_token_and_token_type(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Verifies that login returns a non-empty JWT token and token_type 'bearer'.

methods.name: test_login_invalid_credentials_401_with_cors(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests that invalid login credentials return 401 with proper CORS headers and error shape.
